question:
The volume of a cylinder having diameter 14 cm and height 5 cm is:

(Use pi=(22)/(7))
solution:
__Given:__

__
 
• Diameter of cylinder = 14 cm
 
• Height of cylinder = 5 cm

Concept:__

__
 
• Volume of cylinder = πr²h

 

Calculation:__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d5663d049adcfc967fd5ef4952d4a6ddb899e77def913738880b8ee95876ca.png]
